title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Last night, two local TV channels reported you guys were training in Lakeland. You told me that weeks ago but I am receiving conflicted information today and hearing that MLB wants teams to train within driving distance to big league park.
I am trying to gain clarity on this issue, on-or-off the record. I have reached out to Ron.
Things are ever changing. So not sure yet.
OK. So would it be accurate to write “the Tigers have not made a final decision yet”
Can you tell your VP of communications to get back to me? He’s been ignoring my communication for 24 hours
